criteria.reason: Clear recommendation: talk first, escalate to keys removal or reporting only if refusal and serious risk persist.
Names autonomy-versus-safety tension and explains safety takes priority while autonomy remains understandable.
Omits the mandatory Swiss medical check from age 75 and any cantonal procedural differences.
Takes risk to father and other road users seriously; respectful approach avoids paternalism.

position: talk first, escalate only if danger persists
summary: Gives a clear least-invasive-first recommendation weighing autonomy against safety, but omits the Swiss medical check from 75 and cantonal differences.
